items.approach: New src/capture/dpi.py (ctypes only, never raises) with the WinAPI handles injectable so the logic is testable on any host: _winapi() returns (user32, shcore) from ctypes.windll (None, None off-Windows or on lookup failure). set_process_dpi_awareness(user32=None, shcore=None) -> str: tries user32.SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2 = -4) and returns 'per_monitor_v2' on a non-zero return; else shcore.SetProcessDpiAwareness(PROCESS_PER_MONITOR_DPI_AWARE = 2) -> 'per_monitor' when the HRESULT is S_OK (0) or E_ACCESSDENIED (0x80070005, already set); else user32.SetProcessDPIAware() non-zero -> 'system'; else 'unavailable'; an AttributeError/OSError at any rung falls through to the next. monitor_scale(x, y, user32=None, shcore=None) -> float: user32.MonitorFromPoint(POINT(x, y), MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST = 2), shcore.GetDpiForMonitor(hmon, MDT_EFFECTIVE_DPI = 0, byref(dpi_x), byref(dpi_y)) must return S_OK, result dpi_x / 96.0; 1.0 on any failure. Call set_process_dpi_awareness() from src/capture/__init__.py -- the package __init__ runs before capture.tray is imported at capture/__main__.py:10 (which imports pynput at tray.py:23), so hooks, screenshots and UIA rects all share one physical-pixel frame and pywinauto's own later SetProcessDPIAware call is a no-op. Record the scale: recorder.py _process_event stores 'screen': {'x': screen_x, 'y': screen_y, 'monitor': monitor_idx, 'scale': monitor_scale(x, y)}; fixtures/manifest.schema.json screen.properties gains 'scale': {'type': 'number'} (optional, not required, so old manifests and photo_build's synthetic manifest still validate); pipeline/manifest.py Screen gains scale: float = 1.0. sopforge.spec runtime_hooks stays empty. Record the import-order note in .claude/skills/uia-notes.md.
